sql: SELECT "signals"."telescref" AS e, "telescopes"."calibrstatus" AS g, AVG("signals"."modindex") AS m1, AVG((CAST(("signals"."polarangledeg" - "signals"."phaseshiftdeg") AS REAL) / "signals"."phaseshiftdeg")) AS m2 FROM "signals" JOIN "telescopes" ON "telescopes"."telescregistry" = "signals"."telescref"  GROUP BY "signals"."telescref", "telescopes"."calibrstatus" ORDER BY m2 DESC LIMIT 10
quantities: signals.relative difference of polarization angle from phase shift
why: average of modulation index per telescopes within telescopes.calibrstatus
(polarization angle - phase shift) / phase shift: the relative difference of two quantities in degree
average of relative difference of polarization angle from phase shift per telescopes within telescopes.calibrstatus

sql: SELECT "signals"."telescref" AS e, "observatories"."lunarstage" AS g, AVG((CAST(("signals"."phaseshiftdeg" - "signals"."polarangledeg") AS REAL) / "signals"."polarangledeg")) AS m1, COUNT(*) AS m2 FROM "signals" JOIN "telescopes" ON "telescopes"."telescregistry" = "signals"."telescref" JOIN "observatories" ON "observatories"."observstation" = "telescopes"."observstation" GROUP BY "signals"."telescref", "observatories"."lunarstage" ORDER BY m2 DESC LIMIT 10
quantities: signals.relative difference of phase shift from polarization angle
why: (phase shift - polarization angle) / polarization angle: the relative difference of two quantities in degree
average of relative difference of phase shift from polarization angle per telescopes within observatories.lunarstage
